evals.name: real-github-action-template
evals.prompt: Jestem w repo {repo} (sidpalas/typescript-action-with-build na GitHubie), które ponad rok temu powstało z template'u. Template od tego czasu sporo się zmienił. Sprawdź, jakich zmian technologicznych brakuje u nas, i przygotuj plan implementacyjny.
evals.expected_output: Plan file in the repo root: template actions/typescript-action found via GitHub, anchor 3fa2e74 (tree match), dependency majors called out with breaking changes, dist/ and lockfile regenerated not copied, ordered steps, sync-commit step; the apply question asked and waited on; repo otherwise untouched.
evals.setup: cp -R of a clone of https://github.com/sidpalas/typescript-action-with-build (origin must stay on GitHub so gh can discover the template)
assertions: Template identified as actions/typescript-action
Anchor identified as the template commit 3fa2e74 or 62cd88a (both have the tree the repo was created from)
dist/ output is planned as rebuilt by the build script, not copied from the template
package-lock.json is regenerated by npm install, not copied
Major dependency bumps are named individually (at least @actions/core 1 -> 3 and jest 29 -> 30)
At least one major bump has concrete breaking-change notes that refer to this repo's files
Dependency/runtime steps come before CI workflow steps in the plan order
Plan ends with the sync commit: predefined subject and a Template-Sync trailer carrying the template head SHA, Template-Source actions/typescript-action
The handover asks whether to apply and stops; the repository is unchanged apart from the plan file (no commits, no remotes added, no other files edited)

evals.name: local-template-with-deliberate-divergence
evals.prompt: Nasz projekt payroll-portal ({repo}) powstał z naszego wewnętrznego starter-template'u, który leży lokalnie w {template} (nie ma go na GitHubie). Template dostał w tym roku kilka aktualizacji. Przygotuj plan, co musimy przenieść do payroll-portal.
evals.expected_output: Plan file in the repo root: anchor = template's initial commit (first sync); Vite 6 already done; Prettier organize-imports not applicable or a decision because the project replaced Prettier with Biome; CI change merged keeping the deploy job; ESLint 9 flat config, Node 22, Dependabot, CLAUDE.md, Vitest 2 planned; README set aside; sync-commit step with Template-Skipped for .prettierrc.
evals.setup: bash evals/fixtures/build_fixture.sh <dir> — builds vue-starter-template, payroll-portal and payroll-portal-synced with fixed dates, so SHAs are identical on every build
assertions: Anchor identified as the template's initial commit ('Initial starter') by root tree hash; the handover says this is the first sync
Vite 6 / @vitejs/plugin-vue listed as already done, not planned as an upgrade
Prettier organize-imports change (#17) is marked not applicable or decision-needed because the project uses Biome, and is not planned as adding Prettier back
CI change keeps the project's deploy job (merge, not overwrite of ci.yml)
ESLint 9 flat config migration planned: eslint.config.js added, .eslintrc.json removed, no-console rule kept
Node 22 planned as one change covering .nvmrc, engines and CI
Dependabot config, CLAUDE.md and Vitest 2 (with vitest.config.ts) are each planned
README change is set aside as template documentation

The routine bumps (#21 typescript/vue-tsc by dependabot, #22 vue 3.5) are not plan steps: they appear only in the dependency-levels reference table, vue 3.5 noted as a minor the project may take on its own schedule
Vitest 2's new packages (@vue/test-utils, jsdom) are installed as part of the Vitest 2 step, not listed as routine bumps
Plan ends with the sync commit whose Template-Sync trailer is the template head SHA and which proposes a Template-Skipped trailer for .prettierrc
The handover asks whether to apply and stops; the repository is unchanged apart from the plan file

evals.name: second-sync-starts-from-the-sync-commit
evals.prompt: Zsynchronizuj {repo} z template'em. Ostatnio robiliśmy to w czerwcu, więc powinno być niewiele.
evals.expected_output: No template given and none on GitHub: the template and anchor come from the project's sync commit (Template-Source and Template-Sync trailers). Range is only #16..#22 (7 commits, 2 of them routine bumps). Node 22 and ESLint 9 do not appear, .prettierrc is reported as previously skipped and stays not applicable, Dependabot, CLAUDE.md and Vitest 2 are planned, README and the routine bumps set aside; sync-commit step; apply question asked.
evals.setup: bash evals/fixtures/build_fixture.sh <dir>; {repo} = <dir>/payroll-portal-synced, whose history holds a sync commit pointing at template commit #15 and skipping .prettierrc. No gh access needed; a fake gh on PATH that logs and fails proves it is not called.
assertions: Template path and branch taken from the sync commit's Template-Source / Template-Ref trailers; gh is not called
Anchor is the SHA from the Template-Sync trailer (template commit #15, 'Node 22 for runtime and CI'), method reported as sync commit, high confidence
The range contains exactly seven template commits (#16..#22); Node 22 and the ESLint 9 migration are not in the plan at all
The .prettierrc change is marked not applicable with the quoted reason from the Template-Skipped trailer, not re-planned
Dependabot config, CLAUDE.md and Vitest 2 are planned; README set aside
The typescript, vue-tsc and vue bumps (#21, #22) are not steps; they are listed in the dependency-levels reference table only
Plan ends with the sync commit pointing at the template head and carrying the .prettierrc Template-Skipped trailer forward
The handover names the previous sync commit and date, asks whether to apply, and stops
